summary: Build a role-based digital fluency framework with assessments, learning paths, and AI workflow guidance. Enrol your team today.
lede: A digital fluency framework defines the capabilities people need to use digital tools, data, automation, and AI in their roles. This training is for HR and learning and development leaders, transformation managers, and capability teams building a role-based model. It covers mapping skills to roles, defining observable proficiency criteria, assessing capability gaps, and designing learning pathways linked to performance and career progression.
audienceIntro: The digital fluency framework is designed for professionals who translate workforce strategy into practical capability standards, learning experiences, and measurable role progression. It suits beginner to intermediate practitioners who understand their organisation’s roles and development processes but need a structured approach to digital capability architecture.
audience: Workforce Planning Analysts using skills data
modules: Digital Skills Assessment and Gap Analysis
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, L&D, organisational development, workforce planning, digital transformation, or capability development is recommended. You should bring familiarity with your organisation’s job families and learning processes. No coding or programming is required. Basic spreadsheet use helps with the assessment heatmap exercise, while advanced AI, analytics, and systems concepts receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical engineering instruction.
